title: The Franco-German armistice of 22-25 June 1940 ends the Battle of France on German terms
summary: The June 1940 Franco-German armistice is the instrument that halted the Battle of France.
body: Avalon prints the Franco-German armistice of June 1940. It is the instrument that stopped fighting between Germany and the French government of that moment. It is not a peace treaty and not the 1944-45 liberation. The wording on the page includes: "German summer time. HUNTZIGER KEITEL APPENDIX The line mentioned in Article II of the armistice agreement begins in the east on the French-Swiss border at Geneva and runs thence nearly over the villages of Dôle, Paray, Le Monial, and Bourges to approximately twenty kilometers east of Tours. From there it goes at a distance of twenty kilometers east of".
